items.title: CFTC sends crypto rules to White House to review as Congress stalls on Clarity Act
items.summary: The regulator is moving ahead with crypto market rules as the SEC also opens a new path for tokenized stock trading.

items.title: Crypto tech provider Haruko hit by cyberattack affecting 15 clients, some funds lost
items.summary: Some smaller hedge funds with weaker security controls may have lost funds in the targeted attack, sources said.

items.title: DHS’s predictive policing is unconstitutional, un-American and should be stopped
items.summary: Targeting Americans based on what their spending habits can tell us about their politics is an abuse of our financial system, writes Coin Center’s Laz Pieper.

items.title: ECB President Christine Lagarde intervened to block Binance’s EU MiCA license: WSJ
items.summary: Although the ECB holds no formal licensing authority under MiCA, high-level intervention led Greece to stall an application that regulators had previously deemed complete, the Journal said.

items.title: Zcash targets November upgrade to make private payments up to three times faster
items.summary: NU7 would reduce block times to 25 seconds while setting aside at least 60% of transaction fees to supplement mining rewards beginning in 2031.
